標題： 🎉113學年度畢業典禮🎊事前報名且當日全程參與，享有Apple好禮抽獎資格🎁🎉2025 Graduation Ceremony 🎉 Register in advance and participate throughout the entire event to be eligible for the Apple prize draw!
日期： Fri, 16 May 2025 19:43:52 +0800
附檔： 113畢典QR.png (19 KB)   2025請柬_正面.jpg (2 MB)   2025請柬_背面.jpg (2 MB)   
親愛的應屆畢業同學，您們好：
📣東華大學的畢業典禮即將來臨啦，這可是個超重要又值得慶祝的日子🎊喔！
這次的活動時間是在2025年5月24日（星期六）下午4點🕓️，
全校性的畢業典禮就在體育館舉行啦！

  我們超誠摯地邀請你一起來參加這個睽違以久的盛大活動！
另外，這次的畢業典禮校長有準備精美好禮給本屆畢業生！你猜猜有什麼獎品？🤔
嘿嘿，有Apple iPhone 16 Pro （128G）6.3吋手機一台、AirPods Pro 2*兩組，還有全家禮物卡1000元！太誘人了吧！                                  

  對了‼️這次抽獎只限今年的畢業生參加喔！需事前報名，當天親自來現場全程參與畢業典禮並著學位服才有機會抽獎和領獎喔！
🎯【113學年度畢業典禮】專屬網頁訊息，提供畢業典禮所有相關資訊，歡迎查詢。
活動網址：  http://reurl.cc/4Lr1oK

學務處畢服組 敬邀您一同參與

Hey there, Class of 2025! 🎓
Your big day is almost here. The Graduation Ceremony at National Dong Hwa University is just around the corner! And it's going to be a major celebration you won’t want to miss!
🗓 When: Saturday, May 24, 2025, at 4:00 PM
📍 Where: Gymnasium

It’s been a while since we’ve had a full-on graduation like this, and we’re so excited to finally celebrate together! Guess what — our President has prepared some awesome gifts just for this year’s graduates! 🥳
🎁 What’s up for grabs?
•	1 Apple iPhone 16 Pro (128GB)
•	2 sets of AirPods Pro 2
•	NT$1,000 FamilyMart gift cards
Nice, right?

But here’s the deal — the lucky draw is only for this year’s graduates. To be eligible, make sure to sign up in advance, show up in person, stay for the full ceremony, and wear your graduation gown. That’s your golden ticket to win and receive the prize!
For all the details you need, check out our Graduation Ceremony Info Page:
🔗 http://reurl.cc/4Lr1oK
Let’s make this milestone moment unforgettable — we can’t wait to celebrate with you! 🎉

With love,
Office of Student Affairs –Graduate Placement and Alumni Service Division
